children: GE Aerospace's Flight Deck operating model--launched in 2024 to drive improvements in safety, quality, delivery and cost across the business--is bearing fruit, CEO Larry Culp says on a call with analysts. Under the initiative, GE Aerospace recently reoriented the layout of the production line for its F414 engine, which powers certain U.S. Navy fighter jets. "Using Flight Deck to improve the flow of parts, we doubled output, helping meet our customers' needs," Culp says. "The gains we're driving with Flight Deck are further accelerated with AI," he adds, noting the artificial-intelligence tools are helping to decrease processing time by up to 25% in some cases. (connor.hart@wsj.com)
